description: This file defines the LanguageService interface, which extends a generic service interface to provide methods for handling Language entities, including retrieving languages by code, obtaining language maps, listing languages, and converting between Language objects and Locale objects.

classes.name: LanguageService
classes.description: An interface defining methods for managing Language entities, including retrieval and conversion operations.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a Language entity by its code, throwing ServiceException if an error occurs.

methods.name: getLanguagesMap
methods.description: Returns a map of language codes to Language entities.

methods.name: getLanguages
methods.description: Provides a list of all Language entities.

methods.name: toLocale
methods.description: Converts a Language object into a Locale object.

methods.name: toLanguage
methods.description: Converts a Locale object into a Language entity.
